subject: Decision circle and budget owner — post-demo recap
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Diana Park <diana.park@nimbushealth.com>, Eliot Shaw <eliot.shaw@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 Aug 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Decision circle and budget owner — post-demo recap

Hi Diana / Eliot —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciate the candid feedback on integration points and the latency/throughput goals you shared. Quick written recap and a couple of asks so we can move this toward a pilot: 

- Key decision criteria you called out: reliability at 99.9% SLO, <200ms median token latency for 2–4 concurrent agents, and clear data residency controls.
- Suggested pilot scope: 4-week inference pilot (staging -> prod slice) with 2 model variants.

As we plan next steps, can you confirm two things so we route the right materials internally here and with your team: 
1) Economic buyer / PO signer who owns the project budget (name and email).
2) Procurement and security contacts (procurement inbox is fine if that's the workflow; security lead or compliance contact for SOC2 evidence).

Proposed next step: 30-minute workshop to align on acceptance criteria and procurement path. I can bring a one-pager for procurement and a security-evidence checklist. I attached the call recording and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) for your review.

Attachments: call-recording-20250816.mp3, MAP-v1-nimbus.xlsx

Availability next week: Mon/Tues 10–12 PT or Wed 2–4 PT — which works for your group?

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform for production LLMs

Workshop agenda (30 min):
- Introductions & pilot goals (5m)
- Acceptance criteria & success metrics (10m)
- Procurement & PO flow (5m)
- Security intake / evidence timeline (5m)
- Next actions and owner assignments (5m)

2) Prep items from Redwood: 
- One-pager for procurement outlining contract types (SaaS + PO options) and standard term highlights.
- Security evidence packet (SOC2 summary, data handling, logs retention) for Rita to review.
- MAP-v1-nimbus.xlsx (draft) — attached.

Quick asks for procurement: who at Nimbus typically signs the PO (title is fine) and do you require a vendor form + W-9 before a PO can be issued? If yes, we'll have legal prepare a standard vendor packet.

I'll hold the two proposed slots and update when you confirm. Marissa — looping you in to align on contracting cadence and to bring the contracting checklist.
